introHtml:
Marketing directors planning a winter campaign, HR directors assembling employee appreciation kits, and safety managers preparing outdoor crew gear all share one need: a warm, practical item that carries a brand. Custom blankets fill that role perfectly. Whether you are outfitting a sales team with branded throws for client visits, building trade show giveaways that people actually keep, or creating welcome packages for new hires, a soft blanket makes a lasting impression.

Perfect Imprints carries a wide range of custom blankets in fleece, sherpa, throw, and picnic styles. From the compact KOOZIE® Field Blanket for outdoor events to the plush Bubble Luxe Blanket for year-end gifts, each option can be decorated with your logo through screen printing, embroidery, or full-color heat transfer. Bulk ordering keeps unit costs low, and our team helps you match the right blanket to your audience and budget.
buyingGuideHtml:
What to Look for in Custom Blankets

When ordering custom blankets, start with the material. Fleece blankets are lightweight, quick-drying, and affordable for large runs. Sherpa and velvet sherpa options deliver a plusher feel for premium corporate gifts. The Foxhill Throw™ and Chelsea Throw Blanket offer a classic woven look that suits year-end appreciation or client thank-yous. For outdoor use, the KOOZIE® Field Blanket is waterproof and sand-resistant, ideal for safety managers equipping field crews or for trade show giveaways at outdoor events.

Decoration Options for Branded Blankets

Most promotional blankets accept screen printing, embroidery, or full-color heat transfer. Screen printing works well for large logos on fleece and sherpa blankets, while embroidery adds a premium tactile finish on woven throws like the Plaid Fleece Blanket. Full-color heat transfer is best for photographic or gradient logos on polyester blankets. For a subtle look, consider debossing on sherpa styles. Always request a proof before production to confirm color and placement.

Common Use Cases and Buyer Personas

Marketing directors often choose branded blankets as trade show giveaways or customer gifts that keep the logo visible long after the event. HR directors use personalized blankets in employee onboarding kits, service award programs, or wellness initiatives. Safety managers order bulk blankets for cold-weather gear distributed to outdoor workers. Small business owners favor wholesale blankets for fundraising events, holiday gifts, or real estate client appreciation.

Quantity Guidance and MOQ Context

Minimum order quantities for custom blankets typically start at 50 to 100 units for screen-printed or heat-transfer designs, while embroidery may have a lower MOQ of 25 to 50 pieces. Unit prices drop significantly as quantities increase, making 250 to 500 units a sweet spot for corporate programs. For large events or employee gifting, ordering 1,000 or more can bring per-unit costs down by 30% or more. Always confirm MOQs with your account manager, as some premium styles like the Bubble Luxe Blanket may have higher minimums.

Tips to Avoid Common Buying Mistakes

One frequent mistake is choosing a blanket weight that does not match the use case. Lightweight fleece is great for indoor events but may not satisfy outdoor workers. Another pitfall is neglecting care instructions: some sherpa blankets require gentle washing, which matters if you are gifting to a large group. Also, verify decoration placement on smaller blankets like the Picnic Blanket, where a large logo may overwhelm the surface. Ordering a sample before the full run helps you test size, feel, and print quality.

Finally, plan for lead times. Custom blanket production typically takes 10 to 15 business days, plus shipping. Rushed orders may incur extra fees or limit decoration options. For seasonal campaigns, order at least six weeks in advance to allow for sampling, proofing, and shipping. With the right planning, logo blankets become a warmly received promotional item that keeps your brand top of mind.

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for custom blankets?
faqs.a: Most custom blankets have an MOQ of 50 to 100 units for screen printing or heat transfer, while embroidery may start at 25 to 50 pieces. Premium styles like the Bubble Luxe Blanket may require higher minimums. Always confirm with your account manager.

faqs.q: What decoration methods work best on blankets?
faqs.a: Screen printing is ideal for large logos on fleece and sherpa. Embroidery adds a premium feel on woven throws. Full-color heat transfer works for detailed or photographic designs. Debossing is an option for sherpa styles. Request a proof to ensure the best result.

faqs.q: How long does production take for branded blankets?
faqs.a: Standard production takes 10 to 15 business days, plus shipping. Rush orders may be available for an additional fee. For seasonal campaigns, order at least six weeks in advance to allow for sampling and proofing.

faqs.q: Can I get a sample before placing a bulk order?
faqs.a: Yes, samples are available for most blanket styles. Ordering a sample lets you test the material, size, and print quality before committing to a large run. Contact your account manager to arrange a sample.

faqs.q: Are there different sizes available for custom blankets?
faqs.a: Yes, blanket sizes vary by style. Throw blankets typically measure 50x60 inches, while picnic blankets may be larger. The KOOZIE® Field Blanket is compact for portability. Check product specs for exact dimensions.
